name: audio_max
description: Speaker driven at full output: power, current and the chain's corner

assert.name: full output into the 8 ohm speaker is the cited 1.8 W
assert.because: CITED: 1.8 W into 8 ohm at 10% THD, VDD=5V — Diodes EC table p.4 (replaces the old halved-from-4-ohm derivation of 1.5 W)

assert.name: the rail current stays inside the IP5306's boost rating
assert.because: 2.4 A is the boost output rating, official V1.32 p.2 sec 2 and p.7 sec 9 (the old 2.1 A figure had boost and charge swapped)

assert.name: the input high-pass corner passes bass
no part exceeds its thermal margin at the governing ambient
